reason: Two local GPU workers plus one-request CPU lookahead preserve fixed16 quality and clear the 5-second deadline for the 50-row steady-1s probe, but the burst queue still has 46/50 deadline misses and P95 total latency about 39.9 seconds. This establishes a useful steady-load deployment capacity, not a burst-safe G5 promotion or a service implementation.
next_action: Keep the benchmark as a capacity artifact. Before Phase 6, either add a quality-preserving burst strategy (for example, measured batching/admission behavior) or explicitly narrow the accepted arrival SLA; do not claim G5 passed from the steady result alone.
